In section 5 they list what the coloured bars mean as something they didn't understand. That says the colours are unexplained because the key is far from the bars. It comes after earlier complaints about the inflation button, 'הבחירה שלכם', the filter-chip jargon, the foreign funds with no price, the 4A range, the hedging charts and the staircase starting point. Position 8 assumes the foreign-funds remark counts as a complaint; if not, it would be 7.
